title: Qualify nonfinal replay status and bounded cache boundaries; complete M2 operations work package
commitMessage: feat: qualify nonfinal replay outcomes and close composition work package

contribution.summary: Qualify explicit nonfinal replay outcome statuses, strict no-partial-final-result semantics, cache quota and invalid/cancelled-input nonadmission, version-separated identity and exact replay with a controlled missing-contract RED and thirteen independent GREEN tests; regress qualified composition/IR/foundation and local package contracts; close T2, C03 and M2-W02 without prematurely completing M2.
contribution.value: Consumers can distinguish exact replay from unsupported, budget-exceeded and cancelled attempts without receiving fabricated final values, while completed cache entries remain bounded and isolated across version changes.
debtChanges: The M2 milestone remains in progress pending a separate G-M2 gate and release evidence; its achievement is not claimed.
Nonfinal statuses represent no final value, not invented partial execution telemetry; the original throwing Run API remains supported.
Local cache remains optional/volatile FIFO of 1-32 completed results; no remote persistence, byte-level memory cap or guaranteed preemption.
Context labels are caller-supplied and do not prove provider availability, AURA authorization or cross-platform binary64 reproducibility.
contribution.nextAction: After RS037 succeeds, separately qualify the M2 gate across all six completed chunks, release packaging/integration and nonclaims before any milestone closure or M3 activation.

achievements.achievement: Independent behavioral RED observes absence of a public explicit nonfinal replay outcome contract before the change.
A typed local replay facade preserves Exact, Unsupported, BudgetExceeded and Cancelled outcomes without fabricating partial final values or cache entries.

Thirteen adversarial boundary tests and previously qualified composition, IR, foundation, architecture and locked local NuGet checks verify cache quota, cancellation, identity separation and explicit incompleteness.
Replay and cache boundary/integration task is qualified, with explicit no-binary64-portability and no-provider-authority limits.
Both replay contract T1 and nonfinal/quotas T2 meet the C03 closure criteria.
The three operations-and-composition phases C01, C02 and C03 have been independently qualified; work package closes without asserting the M2 release gate.
